title: PSGraphRender view model
description: The payload New-RenderDocument embeds. Derived from what the module's own code reads: TemplateSets/plain/scripts/bootstrap.js, TemplateSets/cytoscape/scripts/bootstrap.js and elements.js, and Private/Contract/Test-RenderViewModel.ps1 (Resolve-RenderMeta, Assert-RenderContractVersion). Only fields a backend dereferences unconditionally are required; everything else a backend reads is typed but optional. Additional properties are allowed everywhere: plain renders every column it is given.

meta.description: Resolved by Resolve-RenderMeta. Every field is optional; a missing contractVersion is warned about, not refused.

data.description: New-RenderDocument: 'plain reads DATA.nodes and DATA.links directly, and that is only safe because the contract requires them'.

unresolved.description: cytoscape: each entry becomes an External node keyed 'external:' + targetName.

metrics.description: cytoscape: metric ids read from node.metrics[id] and offered to ColorBy.

node.description: cytoscape elements.js builds an element with data.id = n.id; Cytoscape cannot create a node without one, and links resolve against it.

link.description: cytoscape elements.js builds an edge with data.source = l.source and data.target = l.target; Cytoscape cannot create an edge without both.

resolution.description: Contract 1.1.0, optional. Looked up in theme EdgeResolutionStyle; absent means the payload did not say.
